lines.en: I step through the muck, slowly.
Something drips off me as I go.
A heavy smell follows my path.
I move south along the swamp's edge.
Each step leaves a shallow pit.
I waddle forward.
I turn my heavy body slowly.
My steps are rather sticky.
I shift toward the woods.
I plod on one foot at a time.
I squat at the edge of a mud hole.
The smell off me is very strong.
I'm chewing slowly.
This swamp is very quiet.
I pat my own belly.
I pat myself down.
I stretch my body out.
I squat back down.
The swamp bubbles; I count them.
I'm not impatient in the least.
I rest my hands on my knees.
You happen to stand before me.
I raise my head little by little.
You're a little taller than me.
We're a few steps apart.
I cock my head and weigh you up.
You don't look easy to deal with.
I shifted my feet slowly.
There's something in my hand.
Won't you come a bit closer?
I smiled slowly.
It wasn't a pretty smile.
You stepped back about a pace.
I am the king of the dung beetles.
Your breathing isn't quite steady.
This heavy body of mine swayed.
That one hit fairly hard.
I backed away two or three steps.
I slowly steadied my body.
That wound isn't worth mentioning.
I glance down at the wound.
I'm still upright, not down.
Let's carry on.
Is that thing food?
It doesn't smell right to me.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，挪向那味道。
lines.en: I drag my belly toward that smell.
That won't even fill my teeth.
What is that in your hands?
I reach out to grab it.
I squashed it flat.
I'll stick to my own food.
I toss it back at you.
You'd best keep it yourself.
I prefer what's in the swamp.
You hit my round belly.
I swayed backwards.
That bump is barely worth noting.
My body is soft and heavy.
You were bounced away.
I plant my feet bit by bit.
Muddy water splashed up.
You stepped on the top of my foot.
One palm sweeps you aside.
We each gave a step of room.
I'm an ultimate-level Digimon.
I don't discuss this sort of thing.
Standing side by side will do.
You're smaller than I am.
Let's hold this swamp together.
I really don't move much.
We can keep an eye on each other.
There's enough here for us to eat.
Let's just stay here slowly.
That's quite acceptable.
I reach down and pick it up.
Your grip slipped and it fell.
I close it in my palm.
It stuck to my hand.
It doesn't look edible.
I fling it away with a flick.
I open wide and swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 抱稳，我身上可不太干净。
lines.en: Hold tight — I'm not exactly clean.
You've walked into my swamp.
I push myself upright.
My steps sound in the mud.
You've backed to the water.
It's all soft mud there.
I've put one hand up.
I nail the bearing onto you.
You won't get very far.
Only a few steps lie between us.
I lift what's in my hand.
You can't leave now.
I'm closing in slowly.
In the mud, I take one step.
Then let's start now.
I follow you through the mud.
My deep prints stay in the ground.
You've reached firmer ground.
That won't stop me either.

lines.zh: 我们的距离一点点收窄。
lines.en: The gap narrows bit by bit.
Your footfalls land in my ears.
I raise what's in my hand.
The smell is overpowering.
You've covered your nose and mouth.
Only one step between us.
You stepped back a little again.
There lies a pond behind me.
I tilt my heavy head over.
I'm moving now.
My palm swings across.
You were pushed back a few paces.
That blow was soft and heavy.
I grab your bracer in one fist.
There's mud on your armor.
You very nearly slipped.
I'm leaning in again.
I held nothing back there.
You tore free and fell back.
I stand there, breathing hard.
Do you want more?
Let's stop here.
I rose up out of the mud.
Mist floats over the swamp.
Mud slides off me.
I start moving toward the bank.
Roots show through the mud.
I hear something walking over.
I lifted my head up.
The air smells of many things.
I begin shuffling forward.
The mud sinks under my foot.
I'm ready to move.
My smell spreads around me.
I move slowly along.
Fire caught my hide.
I came down and mud sprayed.
The muddy water reached my neck.
The blast turned me around.
An arrow planted itself in my back.

lines.zh: 那道光刺得我眨不下眼。
lines.en: That light left me unable to blink.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的东西少了很多。
lines.en: There's much less to eat here.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，泥都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and the mud charred.
Neither mud nor water lies below.
